name: Chicken Tikka
description: Smoky Pakistani chicken tikka marinated in yogurt, lemon, ginger-garlic and spices, then grilled until charred and juicy.
ingredients: 800 g boneless chicken pieces, similar size
method: Mix yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, spices, oil and salt into a smooth marinade.
Coat the chicken thoroughly, cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Thread the chicken onto skewers with a little space between pieces, or arrange on a grill rack.
Grill over medium-high to high heat, turning regularly, until lightly charred and fully cooked. The thickest pieces should reach at least 74°C/165°F.
Rest for a few minutes, then serve hot with mint chutney, sliced onion and lemon.
tips: Keep the chicken pieces similar in size so they finish cooking at the same time.
Marinate raw chicken in the refrigerator and discard marinade that has contacted raw chicken unless it is thoroughly cooked.
storage: Cool cooked chicken promptly and refrigerate covered for up to 2 days. Reheat until piping hot throughout.
